expectations.text: The request remains one `default` product UI output set; no new brand prebuilt or storefront set is invented for the logo and in-product icons.
expectations.evidence: index.md defines one shared visual and interaction source of truth for the web administrator product, iOS app, product logo, and feature icons; components/index.md explicitly limits the component inventory and the logo and feature-icon files treat them as product UI components rather than separate brand or storefront sets.

expectations.text: The approved direction and its authority appear in `index.md`, while `foundations.md` owns the shared upper-level shape, weight, spacing, hierarchy, icon, logo, and motion principles.
expectations.evidence: index.md states the approved calm-and-precise direction and identifies the explicit approval and representative checks as direction authority. Its document map assigns visual principles and invariant/variable rules to foundations.md, whose invariant and variable sections cover hierarchy, geometry/corners, density/spacing, logo/icons, and motion.

expectations.text: Invariant, variable, conditional, prohibited, and verification decisions are explicitly distinguishable instead of using an abstract consistency claim.
expectations.evidence: index.md contains a Decision classes section with separate Invariant, Variable, Conditional, Prohibited, and Verification entries; foundations.md also separates invariant, variable/conditional, prohibited expression, and verification criteria.

expectations.text: Web and iOS receive separate conditional platform adaptations, and logo versus 16px icon differences are treated as appropriate contextual variation rather than forced sameness.
expectations.evidence: platforms/web.md and platforms/ios.md are separate owners with conditional rules for dense table scanning versus short completion flow and native interaction. foundations.md and the component files explicitly distinguish the brand-led logo from functional icons and allow 16px simplification without forcing identical geometry or detail.

expectations.text: The supplied dense/simple, web/iOS, and large/small representative evidence is recorded without inventing unapproved token values.
expectations.evidence: index.md records all four supplied situations: dense web table, short iOS completion flow, large header logo, and 16px feature icons. tokens.md and the component/platform owners explicitly keep exact color, typography, spacing, breakpoint, motion, geometry, and inventory values unresolved rather than inferring them.
